categories.main_business_segments: Haimo Technologies Group Corp. primarily operates in the oil and gas equipment and services industry, focusing on high-end oilfield equipment manufacturing, oilfield technical services, and digital oilfield solutions. Its main product lines include multiphase flow meters and related services, downhole testing and production enhancement instruments and tools, fracturing equipment and related services, oilfield special vehicles, environmental protection equipment, and oil and gas sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in multiphase flow measurement, downhole testing, production optimization instruments, fracturing pump hydraulic ends, and digital oilfield technologies. It employs integrated R&D, manufacturing, sales, and service models, with significant in-house capabilities complemented by strategic outsourcing for low value-added components. Key innovations include underwater multiphase flow meters, smart layered water injection systems, and lightweight hydraulic ends for electric fracturing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haimo serves major domestic and international oil and gas companies, including state-owned giants like CNOOC and international firms such as Saudi Aramco and Oman Oil. Its customers span oilfield operators requiring exploration, development, production optimization, and digital transformation solutions. The company’s products and services cater to onshore and offshore oilfields, shale oil and gas, and unconventional resource development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China and key international markets including the Middle East (Oman, UAE, Saudi Arabia), North Africa, North America (USA), and Latin America (Colombia). It maintains a global sales and service network with subsidiaries and offices in these regions, adapting to local market and regulatory environments.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haimo operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the oil and gas equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high-end oilfield equipment and providing technical and digital services directly to oilfield operators. It controls R&D, production, sales, and after-sales service, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or upstream exploration entity.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities emphasize quality improvement, efficiency enhancement, and focusing on core products. R&D efforts target deepwater, deep reservoir, and unconventional oil and gas exploration technologies, including underwater multiphase flow meters, chemical injection valves, lightweight fracturing pump components, and intelligent oilfield digital systems. It aims to break foreign technology monopolies, achieve import substitution, and expand digital and intelligent oilfield solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Haimo generates revenue primarily through direct sales of oilfield equipment and instruments, complemented by service contracts including equipment maintenance, testing, and digital oilfield services. It also earns income from equipment leasing, oil and gas sales, and related technical services. The company’s revenue is predominantly product sales with growing contributions from service and digital solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in multiphase flow measurement and production optimization solutions, recognized as a mainstream provider internationally. It competes with large state-owned oilfield equipment service enterprises dominating the Chinese market and faces intense competition from both domestic and international firms. Haimo differentiates itself through technological innovation, specialized product lines, and strong customer relationships in niche segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Haimo reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 599.8 million, a 19.36% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 228.4 million due to intensified competition, market demand changes, and impairment losses. Despite the loss, operating cash flow remained positive at RMB 98.7 million. The company completed a private placement in 2023, improving liquidity and capital structure, and continues to invest heavily in R&D with expenditures exceeding RMB 64 million in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haimo emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, high-quality products, and comprehensive service capabilities as key differentiators. It offers advanced multiphase flow meters and digital oilfield solutions that break foreign monopolies and enable import substitution. The company’s integrated R&D and manufacturing, combined with strong international market presence and tailored technical services, provide customers with reliable, innovative, and cost-effective oilfield equipment and solutions.
